AI That Works Even Without Us 
You can OWN a blazing fast and smooth Agent app. Switch between your AI services, connect MCP tools, automate with Shortcuts, or use local models on your device. 
 Download from App Store 
Available on iOS 17+ / macOS 14+ / Supports Apple Silicon & Intel 
 Read the User Guide → 
Why Choose FlowDown 
Privacy First 
Your conversations and API credentials never leave your device. All data is stored locally or synced via your private iCloud . We collect nothing. 
Native Performance 
Built with Swift , FlowDown is lightweight and incredibly fast. No web wrappers, just a seamless, native experience on iOS and macOS. 
Universal Compatibility 
Connect to any OpenAI-compatible API, including self-hosted models , giving you complete freedom and control. 
Powerful Workflows 
Vision Support: Interact with vision-capable models. 
Audio Support: Send audio messages to compatible models using attachments. 
File Attachments: Add files and documents to your conversations. 
Web Search: Grant the AI access to real-time information from the web. 
Reusable Templates: Save and quickly reuse your favorite prompts. 
Shortcuts Integration: Deep integration with system Shortcuts for automating your workflows. 
Rich User Experience 
Enjoy full Markdown rendering , syntax highlighting, and a buttery-smooth interface that makes interacting with AI a pleasure. 
iCloud Sync 
Seamlessly syncs your conversations, settings, and custom models across all your Apple devices. 
Open Source Compatibility 
FlowDown is fully open source under the AGPL-3.0 license. We invite you to inspect the code and verify our commitment to privacy and quality. 
Frequently Asked Questions 
 Which AI models does FlowDown support? 
FlowDown supports all models compatible with OpenAI API format, including: 
 Major service providers: OpenAI, Claude (via OpenRouter), Alibaba Cloud, ByteDance, etc. 
 Local models: Support for Ollama and MLX local deployment 
 Custom interfaces: Any service compatible with OpenAI API LEARN MORE → 
 Which platforms does FlowDown support? 
FlowDown provides native app support across all platforms: 
 macOS: Full-featured desktop application 
 iOS: Mobile app optimized for iPhone 
 iPadOS: Tablet app adapted for iPad 
All versions are native applications, not web-based, ensuring optimal performance and user experience LEARN MORE → 
 How to use FlowDown's tool calling features? 
FlowDown supports powerful Tool Call functionality: 
 Web search: Real-time access to latest information 
 Document processing: Analyze and process various file types 
We recommend using models like Gemini Flash for the best tool calling experience LEARN MORE → 
 How is data security and privacy ensured? 
 Local storage: All conversation data is stored on your device 
 No data collection: FlowDown does not collect or store your conversation content 
 Direct connection: Communicates directly with AI service providers without intermediaries 
 Open source transparency: Code is open source to ensure transparency LEARN MORE → 
 How to obtain and configure models? 
 On-device models: Use Apple Intelligence or download an MLX model on supported hardware 
 Custom configuration: Support for bringing your own API 
 Import/Export: Support for importing and exporting model configurations 
 Technical support: Provides detailed configuration guides and community support LEARN MORE → 
 Is FlowDown free? 
FlowDown follows a public App Store pricing timeline. The US storefront price steps down to a zero-dollar base app on June 10, 2026, while regional App Store pricing remains the final purchase source. 
Core chat, model configuration, and local storage are included. 
Users can bring their own provider keys for OpenAI-compatible services. 
Future personalization features may use separate pricing. VIEW PRICING → 
 How do I bring my own API? 
Add a cloud model profile, enter the OpenAI-compatible base URL, paste the provider token, add any required headers or body fields, then verify the model before chatting. 
Use headers for provider auth, tenant IDs, or gateway routing. 
Use body fields for reasoning toggles, modalities, sampling settings, and provider flags. 
Keep one profile per provider or model family for easier switching. READ SETUP GUIDE →

subpages.https://flowdown.ai/about/:
About 
About FlowDown AI 
FlowDown is built for people who want a fast native AI workspace on Apple platforms while keeping control over models, providers, context, and stored data. 
What FlowDown is 
FlowDown combines local-first conversations, OpenAI-compatible cloud providers, on-device model options, rich Markdown rendering, attachments, web search, memory, MCP client support, and Shortcuts automation in one native iPhone, iPad, and Mac app. 
Project principles 
Privacy-first defaults: conversation data is stored locally, with optional iCloud sync controlled by the user. 
Model choice: users can switch between local MLX, Apple Intelligence, self-hosted endpoints, and other OpenAI-compatible services. 
Native performance: the app is written for Apple platforms with Swift and UIKit. 
Open development: the source code is available on GitHub under AGPL-3.0. 
Team and support 
FlowDown is maintained by the FlowDown team and community contributors. Support is available through GitHub issues, Discord, and the in-app support flow that exports logs after the user removes sensitive data. 
 GitHub repository Source code, issues, releases, and development history. Contact Email and support links.

# NotchDrop
Transform your MacBook's notch into a convenient file drop zone.
[简体中文 🇨🇳](./Resources/i18n/zh-Hans/README.md)
[](https://apps.apple.com/app/notchdrop/id6529528324)
For Developers: You can use [NotchNotification](https://github.com/Lakr233/NotchNotification) in your app, powered by NotchDrop.
## 👀 Preview
## 🌟 Key Features
- [x] Should work with your menu bar managers
- [x] Drag and drop files to the notch
- [x] Open AirDrop directly from the notch
- [x] Automatically save files for 1 day, can be configured
- [x] Open files with a simple click
- [x] Delete files by holding the option key and clicking the x mark
- [x] Fully open source and privacy-focused
- [x] Free of charge if you do it yourself
## 🚀 Usage
Download the latest version from [Releases](https://github.com/Lakr233/NotchDrop/releases).
## 🔨 Building from Source
### Prerequisites
- macOS with Xcode installed
- Xcode Command Line Tools
### Build Instructions
#### For Personal Daily Use (Production Build)
This creates a production-optimized build that you can use daily on your Mac.
1. Clone the repository:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/Lakr233/NotchDrop.git
cd NotchDrop
```
2. Build the app in Release configuration:
```bash
xcodebuild -project NotchDrop.xcodeproj \
  -scheme NotchDrop \
  -configuration Release \
  clean build \
  CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="-" \
  CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO \
  CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
```
3. Copy the built app to your Applications folder:
```bash
cp -R ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/NotchDrop-*/Build/Products/Release/NotchDrop.app ~/Applications/
```
4. Launch the app:
```bash
open ~/Applications/NotchDrop.app
```
**Note:** On first launch, macOS may show a security warning. To open:
- Right-click on `NotchDrop.app` in Applications
- Select "Open"
- Click "Open" in the security dialog
After the first time, the app will open normally.
#### What This Build Does
- **Release Configuration**: Builds with optimizations enabled for better performance
- **Self-Signed**: Uses ad-hoc code signing (no Apple Developer account needed)
- **Production Ready**: Suitable for daily use on your Mac
- **Binary Size**: ~5.1MB
- **Location**: `~/Applications/NotchDrop.app`

# BBackupp
Back up your iOS devices the way it's meant to be done.
## Statement
Although this software meets my personal needs, I have to say it’s pretty bad for most users. Additionally, it doesn’t support recovery, you’ll have to use [MobileTransfer](https://github.com/Lakr233/MobileTransfer).
## Features
- [x] Effortlessly back up iOS devices.
- [x] Monitor backup progress for each file.
- [x] Perform one-time backups to local storage.
- [x] **Enable wireless backups with IP address support.**
- [x] **Seamless setup with Transferable Pair Record.**
- [x] Secure your backups with encryption.
- [x] Automate your backup schedule.
- [x] **Automatically download app installers from the App Store.**
- [x] Utilize snapshot technology for storing backups.
- [x] **Support for storing backups locally, via SFTP, S3, and more.**
- [x] Receive notifications throughout the backup process.
- [x] Includes a simple alive checker via GET request.
If this app helps you out, consider a [donate](https://github.com/sponsors/Lakr233).
To restore you device, see [MobileTransfer](https://github.com/Lakr233/MobileTransfer)
## Installation Guide
### Homebrew
To install BBackupp using Homebrew, follow these steps:
1. Ensure that you have Homebrew installed. If you don't have it, you can install it by running the following command in your terminal:
    ```sh
    /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"
    ```
2. Install BBackupp:
    ```sh
    brew install bbackupp
    ```
### From Release
To install BBackupp from the release page:
Visit the [Releases](https://github.com/Lakr233/BBackupp/releases) on GitHub.

apps.desc:
CENFC is an advanced NFC toolkit for iOS. Scan, identify, dump, and analyze NFC tags — all processed locally on your device with zero data collection.

SCANNER
Instantly identify NFC tags through ATQA/SAK lookup and protocol probing. Supports ISO 14443, ISO 18092 (FeliCa), and ISO 15693. Accurately detects chip variants and card families, displaying UID, protocol details, and iOS operability status at a glance.

MEMORY DUMP
Read the complete memory of any operable NFC tag. Browse page-by-page and block-by-block breakdowns with parsed NDEF content. Export dumps in hex, JSON, or raw binary for forensic analysis or backup.

NDEF READ & WRITE
Create, read, and write NDEF messages to compatible tags. Supports Text, URI, Smart Poster, MIME, and External record types. Build multi-record messages from scratch and write them directly to any writable tag.

PASSPORT READER
Read electronic passports
